title: What do translators think about GPT?
summary: Tom Gally, a former professional translator and University of Tokyo professor, discusses in April 2023 how GPT-4 and similar models may affect translators' careers. He draws on Japanese-English translation experience.
why: HN links it as an informed view from a working translator on using GPT for translation.

quote.text: Translator for 20 years talking about using GPT for Japanese-English.
